name: process_start
title: Start Process
description: Spawns a process WITHOUT a shell: executable plus argv array (no shell parsing, no quoting, smaller injection surface). Returns an opaque process_id handle; the MCP connection may close while the process runs. Use shell_exec only when real shell features (pipes, globs) are required.

client_id.description: Target HHC client. Absolute routing handle, independent of any connection.

executable.description: Binary to execute (no shell metacharacters interpreted).

pty.description: Request a PTY (v1: accepted, pipes used, noted in result).

timeout_seconds.description: Wall-clock bound in seconds before the process is terminated.

idle_timeout_seconds.description: Session reaped after this long without reads.

status.description: completed on success, failed on error.

client_id.description: Echo of the target host id (null when no host was targeted).

stdout_cursor.description: Stdout resume offset for the next call.

stderr_cursor.description: Stderr resume offset for the next call.

error.description: Machine-readable error code when status is failed.

retryable.description: Whether a failed call may succeed on retry.

tool.description: Echo of the invoked tool name.
